# Runtime and stored data configuration

Process history, service hosting, artifacts, disk use, and reading surfaces.

Defaults come from the schema when declared, otherwise from the bundled YAML. An object
with listed children is expanded below; `{…}` and `[…]` summarize compound defaults. A
dash means the schema has no finite allowed-value list.

## `artifacts`

| Config key                                                                                                  | Type    | Default                                                                                              | Allowed values | Description                                                                                                                                               |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| <a id="artifacts"></a>`artifacts`                                                                           | object  | {`capture`, `retention`} (values below)                                                              | —              | Bounds automatic artifact capture and controls the opt-in retention policy for stored artifact data.                                                      |
| <a id="artifacts-capture"></a>`artifacts.capture`                                                           | object  | {`max_stored_per_agent`, `max_history_scan`, `max_file_size_bytes`, `pool_max_bytes`} (values below) | —              | Limits copied bytes and history scanning for artifacts captured automatically at agent finalization.                                                      |
| <a id="artifacts-capture-max_stored_per_agent"></a>`artifacts.capture.max_stored_per_agent`                 | integer | `50`                                                                                                 | —              | Maximum number of automatic artifact captures whose bytes are copied per agent run. Version-control-backed references are not counted and are not capped. |
| <a id="artifacts-capture-max_history_scan"></a>`artifacts.capture.max_history_scan`                         | integer | `20`                                                                                                 | —              | Maximum number of durable commits searched per file for an exact version-control-backed artifact revision.                                                |
| <a id="artifacts-capture-max_file_size_bytes"></a>`artifacts.capture.max_file_size_bytes`                   | integer | `104857600`                                                                                          | —              | Maximum size of one file copied into the workspace-local prompt-artifact pool. Larger files are still hashed and recorded.                                |
| <a id="artifacts-capture-pool_max_bytes"></a>`artifacts.capture.pool_max_bytes`                             | integer | `1073741824`                                                                                         | —              | Maximum workspace-local prompt-artifact pool size before opportunistic garbage collection.                                                                |
| <a id="artifacts-retention"></a>`artifacts.retention`                                                       | object  | {…} (6 keys; values below)                                                                           | —              | Policy for pruning and trashing captured artifact data after agent finalization.                                                                          |
| <a id="artifacts-retention-enabled"></a>`artifacts.retention.enabled`                                       | boolean | `false`                                                                                              | —              | Enable automatic artifact retention after agent finalization. When disabled, retention removes nothing.                                                   |
| <a id="artifacts-retention-empty_shard_removal_budget"></a>`artifacts.retention.empty_shard_removal_budget` | integer | `2000`                                                                                               | —              | Maximum number of empty ace-run month/day/run shard directories removed in one retention apply pass.                                                      |
| <a id="artifacts-retention-keep_per_label"></a>`artifacts.retention.keep_per_label`                         | integer | `3`                                                                                                  | —              | Number of newest automatic captures kept per label. Set to 0 to disable generation-based retention.                                                       |
| <a id="artifacts-retention-keep_recent_run_months"></a>`artifacts.retention.keep_recent_run_months`         | integer | `2`                                                                                                  | —              | Number of newest calendar months of ace-run directories kept whole before whole-run reclamation may select terminal, unreferenced runs.                   |
| <a id="artifacts-retention-max_age_days"></a>`artifacts.retention.max_age_days`                             | integer | `90`                                                                                                 | —              | Trash automatic captures older than this many days. Set to 0 to disable age-based retention.                                                              |
| <a id="artifacts-retention-trash_grace_days"></a>`artifacts.retention.trash_grace_days`                     | integer | `14`                                                                                                 | —              | Number of days artifact trash remains restorable before purge removes expired entries.                                                                    |

## `managed_tmp`

| Config key                                                                                                            | Type    | Default                                                                                                        | Allowed values | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| <a id="managed_tmp"></a>`managed_tmp`                                                                                 | object  | {…} (5 keys; values below)                                                                                     | —              | Retention horizons and pressure thresholds for the managed SASE temp root reaped by `sase disk reap` / the hourly managed_tmp_reap job.                                                                                    |
| <a id="managed_tmp-horizons"></a>`managed_tmp.horizons`                                                               | object  | {`command_scratch_seconds`, `handoff_seconds`, `build_scratch_seconds`, `run_artifact_seconds`} (values below) | —              | Age horizons, by bucket category, for the managed temp root's per-subdirectory buckets.                                                                                                                                    |
| <a id="managed_tmp-horizons-build_scratch_seconds"></a>`managed_tmp.horizons.build_scratch_seconds`                   | integer | `86400`                                                                                                        | —              | Cargo and other build scratch created for one launched agent (build-targets, cargo-targets). Only the non-procfs fallback still waits this long; the dead-launch backstop reaps unheld launch scratch after its own grace. |
| <a id="managed_tmp-horizons-command_scratch_seconds"></a>`managed_tmp.horizons.command_scratch_seconds`               | integer | `43200`                                                                                                        | —              | Scratch whose reader is the command that wrote it (editors, wrappers, and similar buckets).                                                                                                                                |
| <a id="managed_tmp-horizons-handoff_seconds"></a>`managed_tmp.horizons.handoff_seconds`                               | integer | `259200`                                                                                                       | —              | Files handed to a child process that may re-read them mid-run (handoff, muse-prompts, and similar buckets).                                                                                                                |
| <a id="managed_tmp-horizons-run_artifact_seconds"></a>`managed_tmp.horizons.run_artifact_seconds`                     | integer | `1209600`                                                                                                      | —              | Artifacts sase's TUI Agents tab reads back long after the run finished (launch-prompts, workflow-artifacts).                                                                                                               |
| <a id="managed_tmp-max_removals"></a>`managed_tmp.max_removals`                                                       | integer | `2000`                                                                                                         | —              | Removal budget for one reaper invocation, so a long-neglected root converges across invocations instead of stalling one of them.                                                                                           |
| <a id="managed_tmp-pressure"></a>`managed_tmp.pressure`                                                               | object  | {…} (7 keys; values below)                                                                                     | —              | Size- and free-space-triggered pruning of aged build scratch, layered on top of the age horizons above.                                                                                                                    |
| <a id="managed_tmp-pressure-max_bytes"></a>`managed_tmp.pressure.max_bytes`                                           | integer | `17179869184`                                                                                                  | —              | Managed-root size that triggers pressure pruning of aged build scratch. 0 disables the size trigger.                                                                                                                       |
| <a id="managed_tmp-pressure-target_bytes"></a>`managed_tmp.pressure.target_bytes`                                     | integer | `8589934592`                                                                                                   | —              | Managed-root size the pressure pass tries to return to.                                                                                                                                                                    |
| <a id="managed_tmp-pressure-min_available_bytes"></a>`managed_tmp.pressure.min_available_bytes`                       | integer | `34359738368`                                                                                                  | —              | Filesystem free-space floor that also triggers pressure pruning. 0 disables the free-space trigger.                                                                                                                        |
| <a id="managed_tmp-pressure-recovery_available_bytes"></a>`managed_tmp.pressure.recovery_available_bytes`             | integer | `51539607552`                                                                                                  | —              | Filesystem free-space target used after crossing the low-space floor.                                                                                                                                                      |
| <a id="managed_tmp-pressure-min_age_seconds"></a>`managed_tmp.pressure.min_age_seconds`                               | integer | `43200`                                                                                                        | —              | Minimum age before pressure can prune a large scratch entry.                                                                                                                                                               |
| <a id="managed_tmp-pressure-low_free_space_min_age_seconds"></a>`managed_tmp.pressure.low_free_space_min_age_seconds` | integer | `3600`                                                                                                         | —              | Emergency minimum age before pressure can prune a large scratch entry once the free-space floor is breached.                                                                                                               |
| <a id="managed_tmp-pressure-min_entry_bytes"></a>`managed_tmp.pressure.min_entry_bytes`                               | integer | `67108864`                                                                                                     | —              | Small entries do not participate in pressure pruning. Largest-first ordering already prefers big entries; the typical 0.8-0.9 GiB per-launch target must stay eligible.                                                    |
| <a id="managed_tmp-dead_launch"></a>`managed_tmp.dead_launch`                                                         | object  | {`enabled`, `grace_seconds`} (values below)                                                                    | —              | Backstop over launch-keyed scratch (agent-tmp, cargo-targets, legacy build-targets) for launches that never ran runner-exit cleanup.                                                                                       |
| <a id="managed_tmp-dead_launch-enabled"></a>`managed_tmp.dead_launch.enabled`                                         | boolean | `true`                                                                                                         | —              | Run the dead-launch backstop pass in the reaper.                                                                                                                                                                           |
| <a id="managed_tmp-dead_launch-grace_seconds"></a>`managed_tmp.dead_launch.grace_seconds`                             | integer | `7200`                                                                                                         | —              | Quiet age before scratch no live process holds may be reaped.                                                                                                                                                              |
| <a id="managed_tmp-agent_cargo_incremental"></a>`managed_tmp.agent_cargo_incremental`                                 | boolean | `false`                                                                                                        | —              | Incremental Cargo check/clippy for launched agents. Only hosts with the splitting rustc wrapper (athena) should set this true; elsewhere incremental test builds cost ~9 GB per run.                                       |

## `procs`

| Config key                                                                              | Type    | Default                                                                                           | Allowed values | Description                                                                                                                                                                             |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| <a id="procs"></a>`procs`                                                               | object  | {`history_limit`, `runtime_orphan_horizon_seconds`, `runtime_orphan_max_removals`} (values below) | —              | Retention limits for finished proc records and their orphaned runtime directories.                                                                                                      |

Runtime directories for pruned rows are removed immediately.                                   |
| <a id="procs-runtime_orphan_max_removals"></a>`procs.runtime_orphan_max_removals`       | integer | `2000`                                                                                            | —              | Maximum historical rowless proc runtime directories removed in one owner pass.                                                                                                          |

## `service`

| Config key                                                                                       | Type            | Default                                 | Allowed values                        | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------- | --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| <a id="service"></a>`service`                                                                    | object          | {`procs`} (values below)                | —                                     | Machine-level service procs the sase service host starts, restarts, and stops. Project-local sase.yml entries are ignored; the host resolves defaults, plugin, user, and machine-overlay layers only.          |
| <a id="service-procs"></a>`service.procs`                                                        | object          | {`scheduler`, `gateway`} (values below) | —                                     | Named service proc definitions, keyed by service proc name.                                                                                                                                                    |
| <a id="service-procs-key"></a>`service.procs.<key>`                                              | object          | not set                                 | —                                     | One `service.procs` entry. Every layer that declares a field replaces the prior value whole, including lists; only `env` merges key by key. Plugin-declared and `gateway` entries default to `enabled: false`. |
| <a id="service-procs-key-description"></a>`service.procs.<key>.description`                      | string          | not set                                 | —                                     | Summary line, then a blank line and an optional body. Shown in the Services tab description panel (`d` expands or collapses it) and `sase service proc show`.                                                  |
| <a id="service-procs-key-enabled"></a>`service.procs.<key>.enabled`                              | boolean         | not set                                 | —                                     | Whether the service host starts this proc. Defaults to true, except plugin-declared entries (including the builtin `gateway` entry), which default to false.                                                   |
| <a id="service-procs-key-mode"></a>`service.procs.<key>.mode`                                    | string          | `"daemon"`                              | `"daemon"`                            | Only `daemon` is configurable here; `oneshot` service procs are transient-only and created with `sase service proc run`.                                                                                       |
| <a id="service-procs-key-command"></a>`service.procs.<key>.command`                              | string \| array | not set                                 | —                                     | Launch command: a non-empty string run through `sh -c`, or a non-empty list of non-empty strings run as argv directly. Exactly one of `command` or `builtin` is required.                                      |
| <a id="service-procs-key-command-item"></a>`service.procs.<key>.command[]`                       | string          | not set                                 | —                                     | —                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| <a id="service-procs-key-builtin"></a>`service.procs.<key>.builtin`                              | string          | not set                                 | `"gateway"`, `"scheduler"`            | A reserved builtin launcher; must equal the entry's own name. Exactly one of `command` or `builtin` is required.                                                                                               |
| <a id="service-procs-key-cwd"></a>`service.procs.<key>.cwd`                                      | string          | not set                                 | —                                     | Working directory the proc is launched from.                                                                                                                                                                   |
| <a id="service-procs-key-env"></a>`service.procs.<key>.env`                                      | object          | not set                                 | —                                     | Extra environment variables. Values may reference other captured environment variables with `${NAME}`; `$$` is a literal `$`. Expansion happens at launch.                                                     |
| <a id="service-procs-key-env-key"></a>`service.procs.<key>.env.<key>`                            | string          | not set                                 | —                                     | —                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| <a id="service-procs-key-restart"></a>`service.procs.<key>.restart`                              | string          | `"on-failure"`                          | `"always"`, `"on-failure"`, `"never"` | Restart policy, matching systemd's `Restart=` semantics.                                                                                                                                                       |
| <a id="service-procs-key-success_exit_codes"></a>`service.procs.<key>.success_exit_codes`        | array           | `[]`                                    | —                                     | Additional exit codes treated as a clean exit, like systemd's `SuccessExitStatus=`. Exit code 0 is always clean.                                                                                               |
| <a id="service-procs-key-success_exit_codes-item"></a>`service.procs.<key>.success_exit_codes[]` | integer         | not set                                 | —                                     | —                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| <a id="service-procs-key-stop_signal"></a>`service.procs.<key>.stop_signal`                      | string          | `"SIGTERM"`                             | —                                     | Signal sent to request a clean stop, with or without the `SIG` prefix.                                                                                                                                         |
| <a id="service-procs-key-stop_timeout"></a>`service.procs.<key>.stop_timeout`                    | number          | `10`                                    | —                                     | Seconds to wait after `stop_signal` before escalating to SIGKILL.                                                                                                                                              |
| <a id="service-procs-key-after"></a>`service.procs.<key>.after`                                  | array           | `[]`                                    | —                                     | Names of other service procs this one starts after. | <a id="service-procs-key-after-item"></a>`service.procs.<key>.after[]`                           | string          | not set                                 | —                                     | —                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| <a id="service-procs-key-log_max_bytes"></a>`service.procs.<key>.log_max_bytes`                  | integer         | `2097152`                               | —                                     | Maximum bytes kept in this proc's rotated output log.                                                                                                                                                          |
